transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Please have a seat. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you for seeing me. Um, I guess I'm here because things have been just a little bit... scattered lately at work. I'm an electrician, and usually I'm really on top of things, but recently, I don't know, it's just been a little harder to keep my focus on one estimate or code form. It's not a huge deal, really, just that, you know, a tool will make a noise, or I'll get a text, or I'll just have this great new idea about how to reorganize the workshop, and I just kind of get pulled off track. And then, well, a couple of jobs started getting a little mixed up. I'm sure it's just stress or something, right? I just wanted to make sure I'm doing the right thing by coming in to check on it.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with focus and getting distracted?

Um, let's see... I guess it's been kind of building up for about seven months now? Give or take. Yeah, it started right around the time we took on the mortgage for the new workshop and all the upgraded equipment. 

I mean, it hasn't been awful the whole time or anything, just sort of... creeping up on me. Taking on that kind of financial commitment is just a lot of pressure, so I figured anybody would be a little scattered by it, right? I hope it's okay that I waited a bit to come in and talk to someone. I really just thought I could power through it on my own and didn't want to make a fuss. That makes sense, doesn't it?
Outside of work, do you find yourself getting distracted easily or having trouble focusing on tasks at home or in other situations?

Um, at home? No, I don't... I haven't really noticed it there. I try to be really good about keeping my personal life in order. I wouldn't want to let things slip at home and cause a problem for anyone, you know? 

I mean, sure, maybe on a Saturday I'll start fixing a leaky faucet and then end up organizing the garage instead, but... that's just normal weekend stuff, right? Everybody does that a little bit. As far as having real trouble focusing, no, I think I'm doing okay outside of the shop. I really try to leave the stress at work. That's a good way to handle it, isn't it?
Do you ever feel restless or find yourself needing to be constantly moving, especially during tasks that require sustained attention?

Um, restless? I mean, I guess I have been keeping pretty busy lately. But that's a good thing, right? You want to be productive. 

I just feel like... sitting still is kind of like wasting time, you know? Especially with the new workshop and everything. So I've just been going nonstop, really. Bouncing from job sites to doing bids, and then I'll be back at the shop rewiring test panels. And I keep getting these really great ideas for home-automation setups, so I'll start mocking those up even if I haven't quite finished the last one. It's just... I have a lot of energy for the work right now, which is better than being lazy, isn't it? I just like to stay on the move and get things done. That's pretty normal for someone running their own shop, don't you think?
Have you ever found yourself making decisions without thinking them through, or acting on impulse in a way that surprised you or caused any problems?

Um, impulsive? No, I wouldn't say that. I try to be pretty thoughtful about things, you know? I mean, I definitely don't want to be the guy who just flies off the handle and makes a mess of things. 

I guess... well, I did buy some extra inventory for the shop last month. A lot of high-end smart home hubs. But I really thought they were going to be the next big thing, and I wanted to be ready for the demand. It was just a business move, really. Maybe a little eager, but you have to spend money to make money, right? It wasn't like a crazy, out-of-the-blue thing. I'm usually pretty careful. That's the responsible way to be, isn't it?
Have you noticed yourself feeling more irritable, frustrated, or emotionally sensitive lately, even over small things?

Um, irritable? I try to be a pretty easygoing guy, honestly. I really don't like conflict or anything like that. 

I guess... well, maybe just a little bit lately, but it's mostly just because I'm so excited about where things are heading. Like, I'll be in this really great, big, pumped-up mood, you know? Just talking about how our little shop is about to become the main solar outfit in town. It's good to think big and have goals, right? 

But then... if my wife or, you know, one of the apprentices at the shop questions the plan or doesn't see the vision right away, I guess I can sort of flip. I might get a little sharp with them over nothing. I always feel bad about it, I don't want them to think I'm a jerk or hard to work with. It's just that I get so invested in the ideas. It's pretty normal to get a little defensive when you're passionate about your business, isn't it?
Have you ever had periods where your mood was unusually high, euphoric, or irritable, and you felt like you didn’t need as much sleep or had a lot more energy than usual?

Um, sleep? I mean, I try to make sure I'm resting when I need to. You know, you have to take care of yourself to keep the business running smoothly. 

I guess... well, for the past few months, I haven't really needed a whole lot of sleep. Maybe like three or four hours a night? But I always wake up feeling really good, you know? Like, I'll pop up before dawn and I just feel totally rested and ready to go. I'll use that quiet time to price out materials, catch up on emails, or sketch out a new solar system design. It's actually been really great for getting ahead on work. It's not a bad thing if you just naturally have a lot of energy and don't need as much sleep as other people, right? I figure it's just my body adjusting to how busy and exciting things are right now. That makes sense, doesn't it?
Have you ever had a time when your mood was so high or you felt so full of energy that it was noticeably different from your usual self, and it lasted for at least a week or more?

Um, a week? I definitely wouldn't say it's some sudden, strange phase or anything like that. I want to make sure I'm giving you the right idea here. I'm usually pretty level-headed, you know? 

I guess... well, if you mean just feeling really driven and having all this energy, it's actually been going on for a while. Maybe about seven months or so? It really started right around the time my wife and I took on the mortgage for the new workshop and all the heavy equipment. It's a big responsibility, so I think it's only natural that I've been feeling extra motivated and, you know, just running on all cylinders since then. You have to step up when you make a big commitment like that, right? I'm just trying to be a good provider and make sure the business succeeds. That's a pretty normal way to react to a big life change, isn't it?

Have you had any distinct period — like a few days or more — where your mood was noticeably more elevated, excited, or irritable, and you felt like you had so much energy or drive that it was different from your usual self, even beyond the usual stress or motivation from work?

Um, beyond the usual motivation? I mean, I try to keep things pretty steady, honestly. I don't want you to think I'm, like, out of control or anything like that. 

I guess... well, I don't really think I've had any specific few days where it was totally different from what I've been telling you. It's just been this kind of constant, high-gear feeling since we got the new shop, like I mentioned. I haven't really noticed any sudden spikes where it was, you know, way beyond that baseline of just working hard and being excited about the solar stuff. I'm just trying to stay focused on making the business work. That makes sense, right? Like, it's just a steady push rather than some weird phase?
